steps.name: ci-local-jobs
steps.description: Every manifest step runs in exactly one CI job (scripts/check_ci_local_jobs.py)

steps.name: repo-tooling-sync
steps.description: third_party/repo-tooling is byte-identical to dist/ at dependencies/repo-tooling.sha (repo-tooling built-in)

steps.name: provider-kit
steps.description: Vendored bootstrap is byte-identical to lib-vistoda-provider-kit at the pin (dependencies/vendored.json); fetches the pinned commit into .ci/vistoda-provider-kit

steps.name: provider-kit-test
steps.description: The provider kit's own lifecycle test, run from the checkout at the pinned commit
steps.run: pin=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < dependencies/vistoda-provider-kit.sha); kit=.ci/vistoda-provider-kit; test "$(git -C "$kit" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$pin" || { echo "$kit is not checked out at $pin; remove it and rerun" >&2; exit 1; }; test -z "$(git -C "$kit" status --porcelain)"; sh "$kit/tests/bootstrap-test.sh"

steps.name: auth-modules-vendor
steps.description: Vendored lib-auth-modules matches its pin and tree digest (dependencies/vendored.json); byte-compared with ../lib-auth-modules when that clone exists, never fetched (private upstream)

steps.name: secret-scan
steps.description: gitleaks 8.30.1 over the full git history

steps.name: python-compile
steps.description: Byte-compile the adapter, tests and scripts

steps.name: loc
steps.description: fleet-default preset: 400-line limit, zero growth, ratchet (scripts/loc-baseline.json)

steps.name: release-check
steps.description: Release identity across the adapter, app and engine (scripts/check-release.py)

steps.name: pytest
steps.description: Home Assistant adapter and repository tests

steps.name: audit-lockfiles
steps.description: cargo audit --deny warnings on the engine Cargo.lock

ignore.reason: webpki-roots 0.26.11 is a semver-trick shim re-exporting the fixed 1.0.10; tokio-tungstenite 0.28 still requires the 0.26 name. Mirrors .cargo/audit.toml, which ci-local does not read because it audits from the engine directory

steps.name: rust-clippy
steps.description: clippy, all targets and features, warnings denied
